contract.assumptions: Unmeasured correlated occupancy/global-fold and genotype-by-batch variability can prevent reproducibility. Corrected models count all input genomes;active-acceptor normalization did not measure manufactured yield. Ten ideal decoupled binary dimer cells give at most11spectra,not1024functions. No experimental evolution,practical advantage or historical breakthrough. N1673 is a distinct peptide-handoff predecessor.
contract.costs: Count40 modified-staple stocks,SSDNA preparation,clonal amplification,empty/doublet droplets,photons,failed folds,correlated defects,waste and fresh batches. Equal-information known geometry beats modeled selection in both reported regimes;strong experimental incumbents remain.
contract.provides: Common-bath allele-addressed PDI/6HB optical material is proposed. The source reports executed motif-candidate and synthetic fresh-preparation FRET selection models;physical PDI decoding,clonal expression and recovered functional heredity are not demonstrated.
contract.requires: Same common stock,causal scaffold genotype,constant20PDI molecules,and fresh-preparation photon yield per input genome. Full scaffold routing,modified-PDI thermodynamics,reference survival and droplet compatibility remain unearned.
